- With matching center colors (white center in white frame)

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Right green is locked inside the frame. Let me try UP to move it out
result = action(['UP'])
print("UP:", result.get('board_changed'))

seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['hash'] == 'df604ed27e7e83b0':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
        greens.append(center)
print(f"Greens at: {greens}")

# Try UP multiple times to get it out of the frame
for i in range(3):
    result = action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    greens = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['hash'] == 'df604ed27e7e83b0':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            center = (sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols))
            greens.append(center)
    print(f"  UP {i+2}: greens at {greens}, board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
